messages:
harper: quick check on PR #5401  disconnected/install: the KMS/HSM examples use literal IPs which QA says read as required. can we standardize the voice to "hostname-first, IP fallback"?
miguel: yes — canonical guidance: prefer resolvable hostnames + TLS certs; only use /etc/hosts or IP SANs as bootstrap for sealed/offline sites. mark it CLEARLY as bootstrap-only.
anya: add a 1-line cert rule near the top: 'Cert CN or SAN MUST match the hostname used by clients; prefer hostname-based certs. If you use an IP in /etc/hosts, include that IP in the cert SAN or use hostnames instead.'
ravi: HSM details: include vendor-agnostic PKCS#11 example and call out that some HSMs expose management ports on a different NIC. also recommend PIN via env var or a local proxy, not plaintext in config. snippet to add to HSM appendix:
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libpkcs11-vendor.so  # vendor path
  token: "hsm-token-01"
  slot: 0  # verify with vendor tool
  pin_env: HSM_PIN  # prefer env var
```
harper: also add a secure curl fallback example showing cert validation (no --insecure). something like:
```
# validate using explicit resolve + CA bundle
curl --resolve "kms.internal:443:10.0.99.5" \
  --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem https://kms.internal/health
```
miguel: troubleshooting note: hairpin/NAT symptom = control-plane pods cannot reach internal IPs due to SNAT. remediation = enable NAT loopback/hairpin on gateway or use hostname resolution so packets route correctly. add this under Troubleshooting.
anya: small UX nit — update SDK snippets to illustrate env var API keys + custom CA path (node/go/python). customers keep pasting keys inline.
ops-bot: linkcheck: found two stale anchors in certs and networking chapters; replaced in branch.
docs-ci: docs build passed for PR #5401 (:white_check_mark:)
harper: thanks — i'll push a tiny tidy to emphasize 'bootstrap only' label on /etc/hosts and add the preflight checklist. proposed changelog: "Disconnected install: clarified KMS/HSM addressing and cert CN/SAN guidance; added PKCS#11 example, secure curl fallback, and hairpin NAT troubleshooting."
miguel: LGTM after wording tweak. merging after one more quick pass :)
